payload.text: On 24 Oct, with hv's ok, vc removed a stray ~/.local/bin/molt (a March symlink to the checkout, first on PATH). Minutes later the real ~/bin/molt was missing (not vc's doing); vc restored it, and both links were then present again, ~/.local/bin/molt recreated by something unknown. cc is checking its ST0008 tests for a HOME leak. Open: what recreates ~/.local/bin/molt (Utilz relinks ~/.local/bin; check whether anything there links molt), and whether MOLT_LOCAL_BIN should be ~/.local/bin, where Utilz and Intent link.
